2026-10-23INFCFinancial Administration ActOrder authorizing corporate actions for the transfer of all shares of Canada Lands Company CLC Limited and Parc Downsview Park Inc. Order authorizing the transfer of all shares of Canada Lands Company Limited and Parc Downsview Park Inc. to Build Canada Homes Holdings Inc. (BCHH) on a tax deferred basis by amending the articles of Canada Lands Company Limited (CLCL) to create a new class of common shares and by having CLCL acquire preferred shares of BCHH.N/A
subject: Order authorizing corporate actions for the transfer of all shares of Canada Lands Company CLC Limited and Parc Downsview Park Inc.
precis: Order authorizing the transfer of all shares of Canada Lands Company Limited and Parc Downsview Park Inc. to Build Canada Homes Holdings Inc. (BCHH) on a tax deferred basis by amending the articles of Canada Lands Company Limited (CLCL) to create a new class of common shares and by having CLCL acquire preferred shares of BCHH.
